messages:
Priya: Heads-up — APAC-edge maintenance tomorrow 02:00-04:00 JST. We'll run preemptive network-fallback tests + rolling reboots of ~20% of apac-edge GPU hosts (cohort alpha). Expected capacity hit ~8-12% for hosted pools. No Dedicated evictions planned but you may see brief latency spikes. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/apac-edge-fallback. Can teams ack?

scheduler-bot: Maintenance scheduled: apac-edge cohort alpha start 2026-03-24T02:00 JST (ticket INF-5421).

Alex: Ack. Quick q — which pools/racks are in "alpha"?

Priya: Alpha = apac-edge-rack-a,b,c,d (labels: pool-hosted-text, pool-embeddings-compact). We're explicitly avoiding redwood-dedicated pools. Backfill plan = KV-cache preseed + canary 5% traffic to EU as fallback.

Sam: Can we pre-seed KV cache? I can run the job. Command: `./tools/kvseed --cohort alpha --parallel 8 --target 30m`

Priya: Yes — preseed 30m before window. KV seed tickets will be attached to the maintenance run. Also will start canary shift 40m in.

Mike: I'll update status page + ops channel when window is live. I'll add note: "EU fallback active if p95 > 200ms". ETA 30m to post.

Joan: SRE note: rerouting will increase egress and possibly token unit cost — expect a transient +5-7% token spend for the window. Finance asked for a heads-up.

Priya: We budgeted for up to +10% transient cost. If cost projection exceeds threshold we'll enable embedding throttles and reduce noncritical batch jobs. CC @finance.

infra-bot: Canary preflight checks passed. Network fallback test V1 queued. Canary ID: cid-20260324-01.

Alex: If we need to abort, what are the rollback signals? p95 > 800ms? queue depth?

Priya: Rollback ops: abort if any of — p95 > 600ms for >5min, controlplane error rate >1% sustained 3min, or host flapping detected. Rollback steps = stop rebooting, revert routing, re-route apac traffic -> EU, and escalate to oncall.

Sam: Kicking off KV seed now, will paste logs here.

Mike: Status page draft posted: https://status.redwood.internal/incidents/INF-5421 (will update live during the window).

Joan: Will monitor cost dashboards and set an alert at +8% token spend.

Priya: Thanks all. Small ask: if your team runs heavy batch jobs, please pause noncritical runs during the window. We'll post a final reminder 1h before.

Alex: Acknowledged.

infra-bot: Canary traffic shift started at 2026-03-24T01:20 JST. Canary ID cid-20260324-01.

Sam: KV seed complete — logs: `seeded 14/14 hosts, avg latency 18ms`.

Priya: Perfect — will proceed with the rollout as planned, unless we see alarms.
